name: Hidden
effect: Unseen; rolls against you have disadvantage.
clears: Enemy sees you, you enter line of sight, or you attack.

name: Restrained
effect: Cannot move, but can act from position.
clears: Successful move/trait roll or source ends.

name: Vulnerable
effect: All rolls targeting you have advantage.
clears: Move clears it or source/duration ends.

name: Untethered
effect: Soul knocked loose; cannot act until returned.
clears: Ritual Countdown ticks down; if whole party untethered, snap back with HP cost.

name: Audited
effect: Rolls against you have advantage until cleared; reskinned Vulnerable.
clears: Presence/Knowledge to dispute finding or end of scene.

name: Bramble-Snared
effect: Restrained; taking damage while snared marks +1 Stress.
clears: Strength or Finesse roll to cut/free yourself.

name: Ward-Sick
effect: Disadvantage on Instinct rolls after crossing failing ward boundary.
clears: Short rest or entering healthy ward.

name: Compliance-Flagged
effect: Next time you would gain Hope, you do not; system withholds it.
clears: Knowledge/Presence appeal or leave warded zone.

name: Memory-Raw
effect: First social/memory-related roll each scene has disadvantage until soothed.
clears: Ally comforts you, short rest, or Soul-Quiet Charm.

name: Debt-Marked
effect: Soul-Audit Wraiths prioritize you; GM may spend Fear to move them toward you.
clears: Settle memory/debt fictionally or ritual completes.
